column1: # spira/skip-allowlist.tsv — the skip contract's declared exceptions (testenv/DESIGN.md §3.7).
# A SKIP or SKIP-REQ is green only when its requirement is declared here, for that exact
# suite, and the requirement is genuinely outside testenv's own environment (host-only
# hardware or session state) — never a fixture, a binary in the artifact set, a template or a
# testdb, which testenv itself must provide; declaring one of those is refused outright
# (SkipGate::load), because that is exactly the shape that hid 13 suites on 2026-09-29
# (sp-cln99: the server-mode testdb template lookup broke, and every affected suite SKIPped
# requires:<tok,...>) — copy it from the suite's own `.result` file or its logged line, do not
# This file only shrinks: remove a line when the suite stops needing it, never add one to
